summary: Backend-only regression testing on CleanTec ERP/MES/WMS/TMS API. Ran 27 pytest cases against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering auth (5 roles), RBAC, CRUD (clienti/articoli/macchine), ritiri, lotti with full 9-state traceability chain, lavorazioni, consegne, non-conformita, fatture auto-calc, dashboard KPI, users, audit-log and health. All 27 tests passed.

minor.issue: numero generation uses count_documents() which is non-atomic; under concurrent inserts two ritiri could get the same numero. Same for /api/lotti, /api/consegne, /api/fatture. Use findAndModify on a counter collection for production.

Cookie set with secure=False and SameSite=lax, so cross-site cookie auth from HTTPS frontend won't work reliably -- frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage (per design note). OK for current arch but worth revisiting for prod hardening.
GET checks user['role']=='cliente' but role 'cliente' is never seeded/documented. Dead branch or missing role definition.
puntualita_pct = consegne_puntuali/consegne_totali uses stato=='consegnata' as numerator but lacks a timestamp comparison vs data_prevista, so it measures completion rate not punctuality.
Regex on created_at with leading ^YYYY-MM-DD is fine but inefficient at scale; consider storing created_at as datetime + range queries.

action_items: (Optional/hardening) Replace count_documents()+1 numbering with an atomic counters collection to avoid duplicate numero under concurrency.
(Optional) Clarify or remove the unused 'cliente' role branch in GET /api/fatture.
(Optional) Add true on-time calculation for puntualita_pct (compare actual delivery vs data_prevista).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~900 lines monolithic; recommend splitting into routers (auth, users, catalog, operations, billing, dashboard) as features grow.
Numero-sequence generators are not concurrency-safe (race condition on count_documents).
JWT_SECRET has a safe default fallback value in code but .env provides a strong secret -- default fallback should be removed to fail-fast if env is missing.
clean_doc mutates the input dict in place; acceptable but worth documenting.
require_roles implicitly allows 'admin' even if not listed -- documented in problem statement, verified by tests.
All tested endpoints correctly exclude _id and password_hash from responses.
Indexes created correctly on startup (users.email unique, users.id, lotti.stato_corrente, lotti.cliente_id, consegne.data_prevista, fatture.cliente_id).

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests create TEST_Cliente_X (deleted in same test), plus a few transient ritiri/lotti/lavorazioni/consegne/NC/fatture that persist under LOT-/CON-/FT-/RIT- auto-numbering. No cleanup performed for those but they don't pollute the dashboard significantly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers the full API surface and uses public URL + Bearer tokens. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All 27 tests passed on first full run. Next agent can focus on frontend testing; backend is solid.
